notes.title: One Week Before Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34769087/03d56d5859513dcc28322a96bd33c744240d6cf8.jpg[/img]

I've uploaded final — hopefully, final — build just few minutes ago.

It was long two years of development. The game I see now is different from the original idea. But I feel really satisfied with results of my work. If you cared about story-driven games and light enjoyable gameplay, I believe, you'd like PotAB.

Hope to see you soon in a space of Solar System!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34769087/8d6326f2679142f096a94a21f79ae79b05cc2e34.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey,

We're happy to announce our planned date of release – October 24. Beta testing goes smoothly. Stay tuned!

Also, I added three screenshot and video demonstrating combat gameplay. You can find it at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1016980]store page[/url] among trailers and a bit longer version is available on our Youtube channel.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x-HsOaupWHw

notes.title: Demo Version
notes.notes:
Hey,

It's time for a small announcement about status of development. Some time ago we planned to release a gameplay trailer in June, but unfortunately we didn't. But we have something better now. Intro level of the game will be available for free starting from today as s demo version.

Our future plans didn't change much. We're going to release gameplay video in September. The game itself will be released in this October (more likely) or November.

[u]Currently, only supported controllers in the demo are Vive, Index and WMR. We'll add Oculus Touch later.[/u]

notes.title: Video Compilation: Interactions in the game
notes.notes:
Few days ago, we added a support for Valve Knuckles (aka Valve Index) controllers. This is a good time to show you how interaction with environment works in the [i]Pirates of the Asteroid Belt VR[/i]. Gameplay in PotAB is based on two pillars: interaction with characters/environment and combat. Both are needed, but only good interaction can make VR game really immersive.

Game was originally developed with Vive Controllers, so it will work smoothly with them and Oculus Touch as well.
